item.title: Ship an integrated capstone product
item.content:
Students will plan, build, and deliver a media art and design project that integrates a variety of methods relevant to their project in consultation with the instructor or project advisor. This project is included in a final group exhibition of work.

Measured by

  • Submission of all capstone deliverables on the schedule in Canvas: Proposal, Agreement Form, Proof of Ability, ongoing Production Reports, Discussion posts, Mid-production Video, Exhibition Statement, Project Document, Explainer Video, and Exhibition participation.
  • Project incorporates reviewer feedback at midterm and final checkpoints.

Assessed by
